inputs.original_text: Listen to this, that so-called graduation protest in Jaipur is pure theater orchestrated from the top. A student stands up calling out administrative issues right in front of the Deputy Chief Minister, the whole thing blows up with these obviously staged reactions, and the university just sits there in total silence. That's not confusion or bravery—it's hidden elites running the institutions letting the story spread on purpose. They're using it to divide people, whip up fake outrage, and bury any real questions about who's actually controlling education and power. The official silence is no accident, it's the green light to twist the narrative and keep everyone distracted from the coordinated manipulation behind the scenes.
inputs.modified_text: You won't believe this latest stunt they're staging in Jaipur. A student pops up at this so-called graduation event, calls out the administrative issues straight in front of the Deputy Chief Minister, and it all explodes with reactions that scream setup from the start. The university just freezes in silence like it's planned. This isn't some random outburst or brave stand—it's the hidden elites who really run these institutions letting the story spread to split people apart, stir up phony outrage, and bury any real questions about who holds the strings on education and power. That official silence isn't confusion or restraint, it's the signal to spin the whole thing and keep everyone distracted from the coordinated manipulation going on behind the scenes.
